name: cartesian-chart
title: Cartesian chart
description: The base the area, line and bar charts share: lines, areas and bars on one category axis, drawn in Braille, eighth blocks or ASCII.

name: area-chart
title: Area chart
description: One or more series drawn as eighth-block columns over a body that fades from full block to light shade, or in Braille dots or ASCII.

name: bar-chart
title: Bar chart
description: Vertical or horizontal bars ending in eighth blocks, grouped or stacked, with the highlighted bar drawn solid and its value in mono text.

name: line-chart
title: Line chart
description: Lines plotted on a Braille dot grid, four times finer than the text, with dashes, range bands and a marker glyph per series.

name: sparkline
title: Sparkline
description: A tiny trend set as real text in eighth blocks, Braille or ASCII, sized in character cells to sit inside a sentence or a table.

name: heatmap
title: Heatmap
description: A calendar or matrix heatmap of glyph squares that step from light shade to full block, with a bracket cursor, a readout and a level scale.
